activities.result: Resolve a customer knowledge need with evidence sufficient for the decision.
Detect changing customer needs, language, objections, expectations, and use cases; corroborate them; and compare external signals with first-party evidence when needed.
Collect and code neutral, decision-relevant customer interview evidence.
Design, field, and interpret a survey with defensible coverage.
Extract direct customer evidence from sales conversations.
Extract recurring customer problems/questions from support evidence.
Monitor and interpret public customer/audience signals.
Produce reusable customer language and themes.
Identify pains, desires, and desired outcomes.
Identify decision criteria, triggers, tradeoffs, and disqualifiers.
Identify customer jobs and desired progress.
Explain why comparable opportunities are won or lost.
Explain customer-stated and evidence-backed reasons for leaving.
Interpret feature requests as underlying needs rather than roadmap commands.
Identify meaningful customer differences and propose segment refinement where justified.
Keep Customer Insights current and contradiction-aware.
Find and prioritize decision-critical customer knowledge gaps.
